anomalies.observed: On the FCC I2C bus (SCL=NET0103, SDA=NET0102, shared by U13 PCA9685PW, U14 EEPROM and U16 INA219AIDCNR), the PCA9685 address pins A0–A5 (U13 pins 1–6) are all tied to GND, giving a 7-bit address of 0x40, while the INA219 address pins A0/A1 (U16 pins 7/8) are also tied to GND, giving 0x40. The two devices therefore sit on the same bus at the same address. This contradicts the schematic's own annotation under U13, which states 'I2C address: 0x41' (i.e. A0 intended to be tied high).
anomalies.expected: U13 should be configured for 0x41 (A0 to VDD) as its own schematic note specifies, so that it does not collide with U16 INA219 at 0x40 on the same NET0102/NET0103 bus; two devices with identical addresses on one I2C bus is not a valid design.

I2C address: 0x40 (Power sheet, note under U16 INA219AIDCNR; U16 pins 7/8 A0/A1 wired to GND)

anomalies.impact: Both the PWM/servo driver and the voltage/current/power monitor respond to address 0x40 on the FCC I2C bus, causing bus arbitration collisions and loss of reliable communication with at least one of the two devices (servo output and/or power telemetry).
